subject: Day 1 Check-In: Your baseline morning vs. evening numbers
preview_text: Did your pain start at zero today and peak around 2 PM? Here is your 60-second log.
micro_lesson: Most people wake up with 0/10 or 1/10 pain because sleep suppresses masticatory muscle load. But around 2 to 4 PM, resting salivary flow drops while talking and eating increase mechanical friction, spiking the burn.
daily_tracking_prompts: Morning Pain Score (0-10) vs. Peak Evening Score (0-10)
Did your burning peak between 2 PM and 5 PM?
Total water intake (in oz / liters) and verified pH
Mouth dryness rating (1 = moist and comfortable, 5 = bone dry like sandpaper)
action_cue: Open your printed BMS Tracking Sheet or reply to this email with your two numbers: 'Morning X, Evening Y'.

subject: Day 2 Check-In: The Water Acid Trap (Have you tested your pH?)
preview_text: Is your drinking water secretly keeping your pain receptors wide open?
micro_lesson_title: Why Clear Water Isn't Always Neutral
micro_lesson: Commercial bottled water brands and home reverse-osmosis systems frequently measure between pH 5.0 and 6.0. Sipping acidic water all day keeps Acid-Sensing Ion Channels (ASIC3) constantly open. Switch to still spring water at pH 7.2 to 8.0.
daily_tracking_prompts: Today's Morning vs. Evening Pain (0-10)
What brand / source of water did you drink today?
Did you test your water with narrow-range liquid pH drops or strips?
Any fizzy/sparkling water? (Sparkling water sits at an acidic pH 3.8!)
action_cue: Log your water brand on your Tracking Sheet. If it is acidic, switch to natural spring water tomorrow.

subject: Day 3 Check-In: The Chewing Paradox (Did food bring relief?)
preview_text: Why does your burning vanish while chewing, only to rebound 20 minutes later?
micro_lesson: When you chew, high-velocity A-beta touch fibers close the spinal pain gate against slow C-fiber burning. Chewing also multiplies saliva flow by 10x, surging alkaline bicarbonate (pH 8.0) that temporarily neutralizes surface protons.
daily_tracking_prompts: Today's Pain Score: Morning / Peak / Bedtime
Chewing Paradox Check: Did burning drop while eating meals today? (Yes / No)
How many minutes after swallowing did the burning return?
Food log: List everything eaten today for your 72-hour delay correlation
action_cue: Note whether your pain vanished during dinner on Line 3 of your Tracking Sheet.

subject: Day 4 Check-In: The 72-Hour Delayed Rebound Rule
preview_text: Why tonight's flare might actually be what you ate on Day 1 or Day 2.
micro_lesson: Anaerobic bacteria trapped along gumlines and leaking crowns take 48 to 72 hours to ferment complex starches into subgingival lactic acid. A flare on Sunday is rarely lunch; it is almost always Thursday or Friday's carbohydrates.
daily_tracking_prompts: Today's Pain Score (0-10)
Review your food intake from 72 hours ago (Day 1)
Any hidden starches, breads, pastries, or sauces 3 days ago?
Gum tenderness or flossing sensitivity along any specific tooth?
action_cue: Draw a line on your tracking sheet connecting any spike today back to Day 1's food log.

subject: Day 5 Check-In: The Canine Cornerstone (Tooth 33 & 43)
preview_text: Do your corner canines hurt when you floss or clench?
micro_lesson: Canines take the brunt of lateral grinding forces. Heavy pressure spikes tissue pressure over 250 mmHg, pinching capillaries shut. Oxygen-starved ligament cells switch to anaerobic glycolysis, pumping lactic acid directly into the jawbone.
daily_tracking_prompts: Today's Pain Score (0-10)
Floss check: Does dental floss trigger pain around your lower or upper canines?
Did you catch yourself clenching or pressing your tongue against your teeth today?
Mouth dryness check (1-5)
action_cue: Record your canine tenderness rating on your Tracking Sheet.

subject: Day 6 Check-In: The Ear & Eye Trigeminal Check
preview_text: Is your mouth burning spilling over into ear fullness or heavy eyelids?
micro_lesson: The trigeminal nerve supplies your jaw/ears (V3 auriculotemporal) and eyes (V1 ophthalmic). When mouth nerves overload the brainstem switchboard, neurotransmitters spill into adjacent columns, creating ear fullness, tinnitus, or eye strain.
daily_tracking_prompts: Today's Mouth Pain Score (0-10)
Left Ear vs. Right Ear Fullness or Ringing (0-10)
Left Eye vs. Right Eye Fatigue or Light Sensitivity (0-10)
Are the ear/eye symptoms worse on the same side as your tongue burning?
action_cue: Fill in the Bilateral Ear & Eye box on Page 1 of your Tracking Sheet.

subject: Week 1 Complete: Your 7-Day Trend Analysis & Pattern Reveal
preview_text: Look at your 7-day curve: what does your data reveal about your triggers?
micro_lesson: Single days have noise; 7 days reveal physics. If your pain drops on days with zero dietary acids and spikes 48 hours after starches, you have definitive proof that your pain follows electrochemical rules.
daily_tracking_prompts: Calculate your 7-day average morning pain vs. peak evening pain
Identify your lowest pain day: what did you eat and drink 48-72 hours before it?
Identify your highest flare day: what happened 48-72 hours prior?
3 to 4 mm gum pocket check: are your gums feeling less inflamed?
action_cue: Print out Sheet #2 for Week 2, or snap a photo of your filled Week 1 sheet for your medical folder.
